task: binary supplied toy symptom-match classification; not clinical relevance, safety, dose or best-medicine ranking
preprocessing: DictVectorizer fitted only on unique labelled training inputs; present/absent/unknown remain distinct strings
split_policy: reuse supplied suggested_split only after checking entire template families and scenario IDs remain disjoint; audit repeated inputs and shared context patterns
selection: validation macro F1 on unique inputs absent from training; fall back explicitly to all unique validation inputs only if no novel inputs; stable declared order breaks ties; no test-based tuning
fit_weighting: one vote per unique allowlisted training vector; reject conflicting labels
test_policy: only the validation-selected RF and predeclared baselines; no refit on validation; metrics measure supplied toy labels only
deployment: offline_only; existing application model and deterministic controls unchanged
label_provenance: user-supplied workbook rule-derived toy labels; independently checked against the declared symptom-match criteria; no clinician labels or reviews invented
criteria_note: The above toy symptom mappings reproduce the supplied labels, including headache. They are a separate task from the older relevance experiment and are not clinical treatment indications. The referenced producer README was not supplied.
